verdict.summary: The change correctly keeps group authorization fail-closed: only authenticated requesters with positively resolved, exact group-IRI membership receive modes; missing, malformed, remote, over-cap, or unrelated group documents cannot grant access. Resolution is scoped to applicable ACL rules and origin constraints, de-duplicates document reads, propagates non-NotFound store failures, preserves the public audience, and is exercised through the real sequential and planned authorization paths. The public-surface documentation is updated consistently.
